epic.title: Core Models & Infrastructure
epic.description: Build foundational data models, security, and module structure for NexAML

user_story.title: Create Module Structure
user_story.description: Create basic module structure with __init__.py, __manifest__.py, and folder structure (models/, views/, security/, data/, wizards/) so module can be installed in Odoo.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Module appears in Odoo apps list - All dependencies declared (base, account, mail) - Module installs without errors - Icon and description present

user_story.title: Create Basic Access Rights
user_story.description: Define basic access rights for all AML models using standard Odoo user groups.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - security/ir.model.access.csv created - All AML models accessible to base.group_user - Full CRUD permissions for internal users - No unauthorized access errors during testing
user_story.notes: Using standard Odoo groups instead of custom AML roles

user_story.title: Add Multi-Company Record Rules
user_story.description: Add record rules so users only see AML records for their assigned companies.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Record rules defined for aml.case, aml.alert - Domain filters by company_id - Cross-company access blocked

epic.title: Customer Risk Assessment (CRA)
epic.description: Extend res.partner with risk assessment fields and calculation engine

user_story.title: Extend res.partner with AML Fields
user_story.description: Add AML risk fields to customer records to track risk levels, PEP status, and related factors.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/res_partner.py created with all fields from checklist - Fields: risk_level, inherent_risk, residual_risk, pep_status, etc. - Fields visible in partner form - Data persists correctly

user_story.title: Implement Risk Calculation Engine
user_story.description: Implement automatic risk calculation based on weighted factors (Customer 30%, Geography 20%, Product 30%, Channel 20%) so partners have accurate risk scores.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - _compute_aml_risk() method implemented - Formula: (Customer × 0.30) + (Geography × 0.20) + (Product × 0.30) + (Channel × 0.20) - Risk levels: Low (1.0-1.6), Medium (1.7-2.3), High (2.4-3.0) - Risk level badge updates automatically - Calculation completes in < 2 seconds

user_story.title: Add NexAML Tab to Partner Form
user_story.description: Add dedicated NexAML tab in partner form to view and edit all AML-related information.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - views/res_partner_views.xml created - New tab "NexAML" added via inheritance - Risk Assessment group with fields and "Assess Risk" button - Risk Factors group with input fields - Sanctions Screening section with status and "Screen Now" button - UBOs section with one2many field

user_story.title: Create aml.product Model
user_story.description: Define product risk classifications so customer risk can be calculated based on products they use.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_product.py created - Fields: name, risk_score (1-3) - Many2many relation to res.partner - Basic tree/form views

user_story.title: Create aml.control Model
user_story.description: Define risk controls/mitigations so residual risk can be calculated after applying controls.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_control.py created - Fields: name, mitigation_factor - Many2many relation to res.partner - Controls applied in risk calculation

user_story.title: Add EDD Requirement Flag
user_story.description: Add automatic EDD required flag based on risk level to identify which customers need enhanced due diligence.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - aml_edd_required computed field - Triggered for Medium/High risk based on settings - Visible in partner form

epic.title: Sanctions Screening
epic.description: Integrate OpenSanctions/Yente API for sanctions and PEP screening

user_story.title: Create aml.screening Model
user_story.description: Create model to store screening results to track all sanctions checks performed on partners.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_screening.py created - Fields: partner_id, screening_type, status, match_score, matched_name, etc. - One2many relation from res.partner - Tree and form views created - Status badge: pending/clear/match/false_positive

user_story.title: Integrate Yente API
user_story.description: Integrate with Yente API so partners can be screened against sanctions lists automatically.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - HTTP client for Yente API implemented - POST /search endpoint called with partner name/DOB/country - Response parsed and aml.screening records created - Match score calculated (fuzzy matching) - API errors handled gracefully - API call completes in < 5 seconds
user_story.notes: Requires Yente API credentials in settings

user_story.title: Add Screening Config Settings
user_story.description: Add configuration settings for Yente API (URL, key, threshold).
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - res.config.settings inherited - Fields: aml_yente_url, aml_yente_api_key, aml_screening_threshold, aml_auto_screen_on_create - Settings view created with NexAML section - Config parameters stored in ir.config_parameter

user_story.title: Auto-Screen on Partner Create
user_story.description: Implement automatic screening when a partner is created so sanctions matches are detected immediately.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - res.partner.create() overridden - action_screen_sanctions() called if auto_screen enabled - Works for single and batch creates - No performance impact if disabled

user_story.title: Add Manual Screening Button
user_story.description: Add "Screen Now" button on partner form to manually trigger screening.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - "Screen Now" button in NexAML tab - Calls action_screen_sanctions() - Shows notification on completion - Creates aml.screening record

user_story.title: Create Periodic Rescreening Cron
user_story.description: Add daily automatic rescreening of high-risk partners to detect new sanctions matches.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - data/cron.xml created - ir.cron record for daily rescreening - cron_rescreen_partners() method implemented - Rescreens partners with high risk or previous matches - Runs at 2 AM daily

user_story.title: Mark False Positives
user_story.description: Add ability to mark screening matches as false positives so they don't trigger alerts repeatedly.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - action_mark_false_positive() method - Status updates to 'false_positive' - Review notes field available - reviewed_by and review_date tracked

epic.title: Transaction Monitoring
epic.description: Monitor account moves and payments for suspicious patterns

user_story.title: Create aml.transaction.rule Model
user_story.description: Create configurable transaction monitoring rules to define thresholds and patterns to detect.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_transaction_rule.py created - Fields: name, code, rule_type (threshold/velocity/pattern) - Fields: amount_threshold, period_days, transaction_count - Fields: domain_filter, applies_to_risk_level, alert_severity - Tree and form views - Active flag to enable/disable rules

user_story.title: Extend account.move for Monitoring
user_story.description: Extend account.move to be monitored against rules to detect suspicious transactions.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/account_move.py inherits account.move - Fields: aml_monitored, aml_risk_score, aml_alert_ids, aml_alert_count - create() overridden to call _check_aml_rules() - _check_aml_rules() evaluates all active rules - aml.alert created when rule triggered - Rule evaluation completes in < 1 second per transaction

user_story.title: Implement Rule Evaluation Logic
user_story.description: Implement rule evaluation methods so each rule type (threshold, velocity, pattern) can be checked.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - _evaluate() method on aml.transaction.rule - Threshold: amount > threshold - Velocity: count > threshold in period_days - Pattern: domain_filter evaluation - Partner risk level filtering applied - Returns True/False for rule match

user_story.title: Create Default Transaction Rules
user_story.description: Create default rules (high value, velocity) so the system is useful out of the box.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - data/transaction_rules.xml created - HIGH_VALUE rule: amount > 50000 - VELOCITY rule: 10+ transactions in 1 day - ROUND_AMOUNT rule: amount ends in 000 - Rules active by default

user_story.title: Add Transaction Risk Score
user_story.description: Add risk scores on transactions for prioritized review.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - aml_risk_score computed field on account.move - Based on: amount, partner risk, number of alerts - Displayed in invoice form - Can filter/sort by risk score

user_story.title: Add Monitoring Settings
user_story.description: Add settings to enable/disable monitoring for invoices and payments.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - aml_monitor_invoices and aml_monitor_payments in res.config.settings - Checkboxes in settings view - Monitoring skipped if disabled

epic.title: Case Management
epic.description: Workflow for investigating and resolving AML cases

user_story.title: Create aml.case Model
user_story.description: Create case management system to track investigations from open to closed.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_case.py created - Inherits mail.thread and mail.activity.mixin - Fields: name (sequence), partner_id, case_type, state, priority - Fields: alert_ids, move_ids, assigned_to, opened_date, closed_date - Fields: description, investigation_notes (Html), resolution, resolution_notes - States: open, investigating, review, resolved, closed - Auto-generated case numbers

user_story.title: Create Case Views
user_story.description: Create tree, form, and kanban views for cases to manage investigations efficiently.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - views/aml_case_views.xml created - Tree view with key fields - Form view with notebook tabs (Details, Alerts, Transactions, Notes) - Kanban view grouped by state - Filters: My Cases, High Priority, Open Cases - State buttons (Investigate, Review, Resolve, Close)

user_story.title: Implement Case Workflow
user_story.description: Implement workflow actions to move cases through states for structured process.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - action_investigate(), action_review(), action_resolve(), action_close() methods - State transitions validated - Chatter messages logged on state changes - closed_date set automatically - Activities can be scheduled

user_story.title: Link Alerts to Cases
user_story.description: Add Many2many relation between cases and alerts to track which alerts are part of an investigation.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - alert_ids Many2many field on aml.case - case_id field on aml.alert - Alerts tab in case form - Can add/remove alerts from case

user_story.title: Link Transactions to Cases
user_story.description: Link transactions to cases to review all related financial activity.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - move_ids Many2many field on aml.case - Transactions tab in case form - Can search and add account.move records - Shows transaction details (date, amount, partner)

user_story.title: Add Case Assignment
user_story.description: Add ability to assign cases to users for workload distribution.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - assigned_to field (Many2one res.users) - Assignment tracked in chatter - Filter "My Cases" shows assigned cases - Email notification on assignment (optional)

epic.title: Alert Management
epic.description: Review and triage transaction monitoring alerts

user_story.title: Create aml.alert Model
user_story.description: Create alert model so transaction monitoring rules can create alerts for review.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/aml_alert.py created - Fields: name (computed), partner_id, move_id, rule_id - Fields: alert_date, severity, status, case_id - Fields: triggered_value, alert_reason, review_notes - Fields: reviewed_by, reviewed_date - Statuses: new, investigating, closed, escalated

user_story.title: Create Alert Views
user_story.description: Create views to review and manage alerts to triage suspicious transactions.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - views/aml_alert_views.xml created - Tree view with severity badges - Form view with alert details and review section - Kanban view grouped by severity - Filters: New Alerts, High Severity, My Reviews - Search by partner, rule, date range

user_story.title: Escalate Alert to Case
user_story.description: Add ability to escalate alerts to cases so serious issues can be investigated thoroughly.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - action_escalate_to_case() method - Creates aml.case with alert linked - Sets case priority based on alert severity - Alert status → escalated - Returns action to open new case

user_story.title: Close Alert
user_story.description: Add ability to close alerts that don't require investigation to focus on high-priority items.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - action_close() method - Status → closed - review_notes required - reviewed_by and reviewed_date set automatically

user_story.title: Alert Count on Partners
user_story.description: Add alert counts on partner records to quickly see which customers have alerts.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - aml_alert_count computed field on res.partner - Counts alerts in 'new' or 'investigating' status - Smart button on partner form - Opens alert list filtered by partner

epic.title: Reporting & Compliance
epic.description: Generate SAR/STR reports and compliance summaries

user_story.title: Create Report Wizard
user_story.description: Create wizard to generate AML reports for filing SAR/STR and compliance summaries.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - wizards/aml_report_wizard.py created - Report types: SAR, STR, Periodic Summary, Risk Summary - Fields: report_type, date_from, date_to, partner_ids, case_ids, format - Formats: PDF, Excel, goAML XML - action_generate_report() method

user_story.title: Generate SAR Report
user_story.description: Implement SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) generation for regulatory filing.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - _generate_sar() method implemented - Collects case data, partner info, transactions - PDF format with narrative, timeline, supporting data - goAML XML export option - Report saved as attachment to case
user_story.notes: May require AI service for narrative generation

user_story.title: Generate STR Report
user_story.description: Implement STR (Suspicious Transaction Report) generation for specific transactions.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - _generate_str() method implemented - Focused on specific transactions - Transaction details, customer info, reason for suspicion - PDF and goAML XML formats

user_story.title: Generate Periodic Compliance Summary
user_story.description: Create periodic compliance summaries for management reporting on AML activities.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Summary includes: cases opened/closed, alerts generated, screenings performed - High-risk customer count - Charts: cases by type, alerts by severity - Excel and PDF formats

user_story.title: Generate Customer Risk Summary
user_story.description: Create customer risk summaries to review risk profiles in bulk.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Lists selected customers with risk levels - Includes: inherent risk, residual risk, EDD status - Shows last assessment date, next review date - Excel export for analysis

user_story.title: Implement goAML XML Export
user_story.description: Implement goAML XML export to submit reports to regulatory authorities.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - goAML schema compliance - XML includes: report header, subject info, transaction details, narrative - Validates against goAML XSD - Downloadable as .xml file

user_story.title: Optional AI Narrative Generation
user_story.description: Add optional AI-generated narratives for reports to save time writing summaries.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - AI service integration (if configured) - Generates narrative from case data - Editable before report finalization - Gracefully degrades if AI unavailable
user_story.notes: Optional feature - requires external AI service

epic.title: Configuration & Settings
epic.description: Admin settings for AML module configuration

user_story.title: Add AML Settings to Configuration
user_story.description: Add centralized AML settings for module configuration without code changes.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - models/res_config_settings.py inherits res.config.settings - All config fields defined with config_parameter - Settings accessible via Settings > General Settings - Values persist across restarts

user_story.title: Create Settings View
user_story.description: Create user-friendly settings interface to configure NexAML easily.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - views/res_config_settings_views.xml created - NexAML section with organized subsections - Sections: Sanctions Screening, Risk Assessment, Transaction Monitoring, AI Services - Help text for each setting - Save button persists changes

epic.title: Menu & Navigation
epic.description: Main menu structure and navigation for NexAML

user_story.title: Create Main Menu Structure
user_story.description: Create main menu for NexAML to navigate to all AML features.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - views/menu.xml created - Top-level menu "NexAML" with icon - Submenus: Dashboard, Operations, Configuration, Reporting - Operations: Cases, Alerts, Screenings - All menus link to correct actions

user_story.title: Create Dashboard View
user_story.description: Create dashboard to see key metrics at a glance.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Dashboard shows: new alerts count, open cases count, high-risk partners count - Links to filtered views (e.g., click alert count opens new alerts) - Charts: cases by state, alerts by severity - Refreshes data in real-time
user_story.notes: May use Odoo's dashboard framework or custom view

user_story.title: Write Unit Tests
user_story.description: Write unit tests for core functionality to catch regressions early.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - tests/ directory created - Tests for risk calculation - Tests for rule evaluation - Tests for screening API integration - Tests for case workflow - 80%+ code coverage

user_story.title: Integration Testing
user_story.description: Create integration tests to validate end-to-end workflows.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Test: Create partner → auto-screen → alert generated → escalate to case → resolve - Test: Create transaction → rule triggered → alert created - Test: Generate SAR report from case - All tests pass in clean database

user_story.title: Create User Documentation
user_story.description: Create user documentation for learning how to use NexAML.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - User guide in PDF/HTML - Sections: Getting Started, Risk Assessment, Screening, Monitoring, Cases, Reporting - Screenshots for each major feature - FAQ section - Troubleshooting guide

user_story.title: Create Technical Documentation
user_story.description: Create technical documentation for customization and maintenance.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - README.md with installation instructions - Architecture overview - Model relationships diagram - API integration guide (Yente) - Configuration reference - Code comments and docstrings

user_story.title: UAT with Compliance Team
user_story.description: Conduct UAT with compliance team to ensure module meets regulatory requirements.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - UAT environment set up - Test scenarios documented - Compliance team trained on module - Feedback collected and addressed - Sign-off from compliance officer

user_story.title: Production Deployment Checklist
user_story.description: Create deployment checklist for smooth production rollout.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Backup existing database - Install module in production - Configure Yente API credentials - Set up cron jobs - Verify multi-company settings - Test with sample data - Monitor logs for errors

user_story.title: Performance Monitoring Setup
user_story.description: Set up monitoring for NexAML to detect performance issues.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Monitor risk calculation time - Monitor API call latency (Yente) - Monitor transaction monitoring overhead - Alert on errors or timeouts - Dashboard for key metrics

user_story.title: Data Migration Plan
user_story.description: Create migration plan for existing customers to have initial risk assessments.
user_story.acceptance_criteria: - Script to assign default risk factors to existing partners - Bulk risk assessment for all customers - Verify data quality after migration - Rollback plan in case of issues
